name: JE_NET_AGREEMENTS
description: JE_NET_AGREEMENTS contains general information about netting agreements.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Netting agreement identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the netting agreement.

columns.name: PARTNER_REFERENCE
columns.description: Trading partner reference.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the netting agreement.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the netting agreement.

columns.name: IN_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the agreement is currently being used in the netting process.

columns.name: SEL_REC_PAST_DUE_TXNS_FLAG
columns.description: While processing a netting batch, it indicates whether to select only those Oracle Receivables transactions whose due date is on or before the date of the netting batch.

columns.name: DAYS_PAST_DUE
columns.description: Number of days past due for Oracle Receivable transactions.

columns.name: NET_CURRENCY_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Netting currency grouping or conversion rule.

columns.name: NET_ORDER_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Netting rule which determines the order to sort transactions.

columns.name: NET_BALANCE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Netting rule based on Oracle Payables and Receivables balances.

columns.name: SHIKYU_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether to include or exclude invoices based on their Shikyu value, or to disregard the value altogether. Used in Japan only.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Netting bank account identifier.

columns.name: NET_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code.

columns.name: APPROVER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the approver of the netting batch.

columns.name: NON_RESPONSE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action for not responding to netting batch approval.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Action to non response for netting batch approval.

columns.name: ALLOW_DISCOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the netting process includes discounts on transactions.

columns.name: NETTING_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Used to define a grouping for netting agreements. Values are from the lookup Netting Group Type.

columns.name: LETTER_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the recipient when delivering netting letters through bursting.

columns.name: LETTER_TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location reference for trading partner.

columns.name: LETTER_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Netting letter language specified by the trading partner.

columns.name: LETTER_FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the sender when delivering netting letters through bursting.

columns.name: LETTER_FROM_NAME
columns.description: Display name of the sender that will be used when delivering netting letters through bursting.

columns.name: LETTER_REPLY_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Reply to e-mail address that will be used when delivering netting letters through bursting.

columns.name: LETTER_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether netting letters should be created.

columns.name: LETTER_BURSTING_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether bursting should be used to automatically deliver netting letters by e-mail.

columns.name: INCLUDED_PAY_GROUPS_CODE
columns.description: Pay groups that must either be included or excluded for the netting agreement. Possible values are A (All), I (Include) and E (Exclude).

columns.name: INCLUDED_TRX_TYPES_CODE
columns.description: Transaction types that must either be included or excluded for the netting agreement. Possible values are A (All), I (Include) and E (Exclude).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
